chapter.heading: Greeting the Elect Lady
chapter.v:
The Elder,To
the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not only I, but also all those who have known the truth, [Jer. 51:48; Rev.]

because of
the truth which abides in us and will be with us forever: [Rev. 15:3; 16:7]

Grace, mercy,
and peace will be with you from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.Walk in Christ’s Commandments [Is. 34:10; Rev.]

I rejoiced
greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, as we received commandment from the Father. [Rev. 4:4, 6,]

And now
I plead with you, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment to you, but that which we have had from the beginning: that we love one another. [Ps. 134:1 i Rev.]

This is
love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the commandment, that as you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in it.Beware of Antichrist Deceivers [Ezek. 1:24; Rev.]

For many
deceivers have gone out into the world who do not confess Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist. [[Matt. 22:2;]

Look to
yourselves, that we do not lose those things we worked for, but that we may receive a full reward. [Ps. 45:13;]

Whoever transgresses
and does not abide in the doctrine of Christ does not have God. He who abides in the doctrine of Christ has both the Father and the Son. [Matt. 22:2;]

for he
who greets him shares in his evil deeds.John’s Farewell Greeting [Rev. 15:5] [Ps. 45:3, 4; Rev. 6:2; 19:19,] [Ps. 96:13;]

Having many
things to write to you, I did not wish to do so with paper and ink; but I hope to come to you and speak face to face, that our joy may be full. [Dan. 10:6;]

The children
of your elect sister greet you. Amen. [Is. 63:2, 3 $]
